I can’t reliably evaluate this many sequential swaps by hand, so I don’t want to invent final values. In R, append this after the assignments to print the requested line:

```r
cat(sprintf(
  "ANSWER: a ?= %s; b ?= %s; c ?= %s; d ?= %s; e ?= %s; f ?= %s; g ?= %s; h ?= %s; i ?= %s; j ?= %s; k ?= %s; l ?= %s; m ?= %s; n ?= %s; o ?= %s; p ?= %s; TMP ?= %s;\n",
  a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, k, l, m, n, o, p, TMP
))
```
